suggested_requirements.text: The system shall receive data from the Correlator in real-time.
The system shall assemble time-series from the Correlator lag output.
The system shall perform Fourier Transforms of the assembled time series.
The system shall deliver formatted results to the End-to-End System.
The system shall receive Lag Frames from the Correlator.
The system shall receive State Count data from the M&C system.
The system shall receive observational mode parameters from the M&C system.
The system shall provide operational status data to the M&C system.
The system shall provide error and warning reports to the M&C system.
The system shall verify successful delivery of output to the e2e system.
The system shall handle lag frames of less than 128 values.
The system shall handle lag sets up to a maximum size of 262,144 values.
The system shall replace all invalid data with zero values.
The system shall perform windowing operations prior and subsequent to Fourier Transform.
The system shall sum the frequency domain spectral results.
The system shall monitor data transfer rates from the Correlator and to the e2e.
The system shall monitor the overall data processing rate.
The system shall trap, flag and repair computation errors.
The system shall check PID's to assure that all started tasks are alive and running.
The system shall check Backend physical processors to assure that all needed processors are alive.
The system shall check all Backend internal networks to assure that all communication connections are intact.
The system shall initiate a processing task on any Backend processor.
The system shall signal a kill for any Backend process.
The system shall alter the priority of any of the BE tasks.
The system shall initiate a reboot of any Backend physical processor.
The system shall initiate a reboot of any internal network.
The system shall redistribute internal workload among its processors.
All users of the system shall login using unique identification.
All login attempts shall be done in a secure manner.
A system administrator shall have unrestricted access to all aspects of the system.
Each user shall have a set of system access properties that defines the user’s privileges.
The administrator shall have the ability to create, add, remove, and edit users.
The administrator shall have the ability to block all access to the system for all users or selectively by user.
The system shall be capable of accepting an aggregate data input stream from the Correlator of a minimum of 1.6 Gbytes/sec.
The system shall be capable of delivering an output data stream to the e2e System of a minimum of 25 MBytes/sec.
The system shall be self-monitoring and capable of detecting and automatically remedying abnormal conditions.
The system shall continue to operate in a loss-less manner in the event of a temporary loss of availability of the e2e System.
The system shall be scaleable to handle up to two Gbytes per second per Correlator output channel in real-time.
Operations performed shall be reversible, such that the original raw uncorrected data is recoverable from the processing output.
